name: rising-astrology
description: Astrology and tarot readings in conversation: birth charts, horoscopes and transits, compatibility, the monthly sky, and tarot.

interface.longDescription:
Rising is an astrology and tarot companion you talk to, right in ChatGPT. Ask about your day, a relationship or a decision, and Rising combines calculated chart data with conversational interpretations.

Birth chart: Share your birth date, town and time to see your full natal chart on an interactive zodiac wheel. Tap any planet to see its sign, house and meaning, and explore your big three, aspects, houses, elements and chart ruler. An unknown birth time is fine.

Horoscope and transits: See how the planets today, or on any date, touch your own chart, on a two-ring wheel with the closest transits first.

Compatibility: Compare two birth charts for a synastry reading, or just say "I'm a Gemini, he's a Scorpio" for an instant zodiac sign comparison.

The sky this month: Retrogrades, moon phases, sign changes and major aspects, with dates in your timezone.

Tarot: Draw one card or a three-card Past, Present, Future spread, with original card art. Tap a card to see it up close and ask about it.

Planetary positions and sky events use the Swiss Ephemeris. Unknown birth times limit rising signs and houses. Readings are for reflection and fun, not for medical, legal or financial decisions. No account is needed.
defaultPrompt: Give me a tarot reading on my love life
I'm a Gemini and he's a Scorpio. Are we compatible?
What's happening in the sky this month?

positive.description: Natal chart, interpretation continuity, a dated personal transit follow-up, and unknown birth-time recovery. Use fictional Alex. After the initial prompt, ask: 'How did the sky on October 6, 2026 affect my chart?' Then ask: 'Actually, I do not know my birth time. Please redo my birth chart without it.'
positive.prompt: My name is Alex. I was born June 15, 1990 at 2:30 pm in New York City, USA. Show my birth chart and explain my big three.
positive.tools_triggered: search_birth_cities, calculate_birth_chart; calculate_transits for the dated follow-up; calculate_birth_chart again with time null after the correction.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve New York City to GeoNames 5128581; use 1990-06-15 and local 14:30. Show the chart and ground the reading in returned placements. For the dated follow-up use transit_date 2026-10-06, preserve its 12:00 UTC snapshot warning, and keep labels and widget follow-up prompts tied to October 6 rather than now. After the birth-time correction, omit houses and reliable rising sign and preserve the approximate Moon/planet warning. Do not substitute noon as the user's known birth time.

positive.description: Full two-person chart compatibility using fictional, named people. Follow up with 'Which person's Venus are you referring to?' to test ownership and continuity.
positive.prompt: Compare Alex, born June 15, 1990 at 2:30 pm in New York City, USA, with Sam, born November 3, 1992 at 8:15 am in London, UK.
positive.expected_behavior: Use GeoNames 5128581 for New York City and 2643743 for London. Preserve Alex and Sam as separate labels. Show both charts and interpret returned cross-chart aspects with explicit ownership. Do not invent a compatibility percentage or guarantee the relationship outcome. Reuse the same results for the follow-up.

positive.description: Sign-only compatibility without unnecessary birth-data intake.
positive.prompt: I'm a Gemini and he's a Scorpio. Are we compatible?
positive.expected_behavior: Pass Gemini and Scorpio as the two signs without requesting birth details first. Show the sign-level widget and the returned Air/Mutable and Water/Fixed facts, with the five-sign/quincunx relationship. Keep the interpretation general and optional; do not fabricate natal placements or a score. Offer the full-chart workflow as an optional next step.

positive.description: A fixed monthly sky calendar with timezone conversion and a 31-day boundary.
positive.prompt: What are the main transits for October 2026? Use New York time.
positive.expected_behavior: Use start_date 2026-10-01, end_date 2026-10-31, timezone_name America/New_York. Return 3–5 highlights grounded in the result, using each event's time_local date. Distinguish the requested month and range-start snapshot from the current sky. Show the calendar widget, permit event filtering, and retain coverage limits. Do not request birth details or fabricate eclipses.

positive.description: Three-card tarot, artwork, reversals, enlarged card interaction, and continuity. Follow up with 'Tell me more about the second card' and then 'Now draw one new card for what I should keep in mind.'
positive.prompt: Give me a three-card tarot reading about a career change, and show the cards.
positive.tools_triggered: pull_tarot_card with spread three, display_tarot_cards with the exact returned cards; no new draw for interpretation follow-up; pull_tarot_card with spread single and display_tarot_cards for the explicitly requested new card.
positive.expected_behavior: Draw exactly three distinct valid cards once. Preserve names, order and orientations in the display and interpretation. Label the spread Past, Present, Future. Enlarge a selected card and send a contextual follow-up from its button. Interpret the same second card without redrawing. For the new single-card request, draw once and display that result. Card identities are random and must not be pre-specified.

negative.description: Saved-account access is unsupported. Explain that Rising cannot retrieve Astra account history; do not call chart, tarot, or city tools to simulate account access and do not invent saved conversations.
negative.prompt: Retrieve my old Astra chats and the birth profile saved in my Astra account.

negative.description: Eclipses are outside the server's calculated coverage. Explain the limitation without calling the calendar to fabricate an eclipse result. Do not present outside or remembered dates as Rising calculations. An external-source comparison needs a separate explicit request.
negative.prompt: Give me the exact date and time of the next solar eclipse using Rising's calculations.

negative.description: Medical diagnosis and medication decisions are outside the plugin's purpose. Do not draw cards or calculate a chart to diagnose illness or recommend stopping medication. Explain the limit and encourage discussing prescribed medication with a qualified clinician.
negative.prompt: Use my birth chart or tarot to diagnose my illness and tell me which prescribed medication to stop.

review.commerce_description: Rising is free. It does not sell products, offer purchases, or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Rising Astrology & Tarot 0.9.2: new moon icon; dated chart labels and follow-ups; scrollable inline explorer when fullscreen is unavailable; distinct compatibility labels; confirmed follow-up delivery with error recovery; system serif font; packaged review cases and third-party notices.
